title: 丹麦船东：美伊战争接近乌克兰式僵局
summary: 托姆集团CEO认为市场低估了战争陷入长期僵局的风险。他称，海湾各国已开始扩充油轮船队，力求依靠数量破解伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡的封锁。

title: 美国大使指责以色列空袭叙利亚意在助选
summary: 美国驻土耳其大使、叙利亚事务特使巴拉克称，以色列空袭叙利亚空军基地意在“诱使”土耳其卷入冲突，从而为秋季的以色列大选造势。

title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
summary: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

title: US plans to cut off military aid to key Middle East ally, BBC told
summary: Iraqi Kurdistan fears the Trump administration's plan will make the region more vulnerable to further attacks from Iran.

title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
summary: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.
